note: Maximum operating temperature (Tjmax) AMD lists per desktop Ryzen model, in degrees Celsius. Taken from a research report that cites AMD's own product page for each model; the app's author could not open AMD's pages and cross-checked 8 models against Technical City (2600, 3600XT, 3800XT, 5600X, 5800X, 7800X3D, 7950X3D and the 2600X), all of which agreed. The app compares the figure with the Tctl reading, which is the same as Tdie on every model here. Left out on purpose: models whose Tctl carries an offset (Ryzen 5 1600X, 7 1700X/1800X/2700X and Threadripper), models sold in two silicon versions under one name (1600, 1200), models whose figure came from a secondary source or could not be confirmed, laptop and embedded parts. A model that is not in the list has no known limit and the app says so instead of guessing. To add one: check AMD's page for it first.
